about: A foreign key with no index led by its columns is a full read of the child table at each delete of a parent row. One is allowed only when its parent's rows are never deleted (neverDeleted, by parent) or when it is listed by itself with its reason (keys, by "table(columns)"). packages/store/src/core/foreign-key-indexes.db.test.ts fails on an unindexed key allowed by neither, on an entry no such key needs, and on a neverDeleted parent that a statement of the store or of a migration deletes from or that a cascading key deletes.

keys.knowledge.accounts(entity_id): Its parent is deleted, and the key check skip-scans the label-led index on the same column; a plain index would give a reader statement a path past the label key.
keys.knowledge.aliases(entity_id): Its parent is deleted, and the key check skip-scans the label-led index on the same column; a plain index would give a reader statement a path past the label key.

keys.knowledge.interaction_log(entity_id): Its parent is deleted, and the key check skip-scans the label-led index on the same column; a plain index would give a reader statement a path past the label key.

neverDeleted.knowledge.areas: An area is retired by its state, never deleted: its projects keep it.
neverDeleted.knowledge.owner_decisions: The owner's decisions are append-only: a decision is lifted or superseded by a newer one, and an erasure taints one, never deletes it.
neverDeleted.knowledge.projects: A project stays once made; a merge points it at another (merged_into) and its status says so.
neverDeleted.ledger.agent_messages: Agent mail is append-only; a reply points at the message it answers.
neverDeleted.ledger.agent_writes: An agent record is kept by its ids when its body is removed (tainted_at, body_enc dropped).
neverDeleted.ledger.cards: A card is closed by its status events, or tainted (tainted_at); never deleted. The cascading keys from it (ledger.card_name_holds, ledger.health_notices) state that the child means nothing without its card; they never fire, since the parent row is never deleted.
neverDeleted.ledger.exposures: Exposures are the record of what left the store; never deleted.
neverDeleted.ledger.improvements: The improvement store is append-only; a duplicate points at the one it repeats.
neverDeleted.ledger.memory_exposures: Exposures are the record of what left the store; never deleted.
neverDeleted.ledger.memory_projections: What a client's memory file was served is append-only.
neverDeleted.ledger.opportunities: An opportunity is closed by its decisions and events, or tainted (tainted_at); never deleted. The cascading keys from it (ledger.work_notices, ledger.work_declines) state that the child means nothing without its opportunity; they never fire, since the parent row is never deleted.
neverDeleted.ledger.sent_messages: A send is the record of what left the store; never deleted.
neverDeleted.ledger.sessions: Sessions are the record of who called; never deleted.
neverDeleted.policy.clients: A client is revoked (status, revoked_at), never deleted, so what it did keeps its author.
neverDeleted.policy.harness_modes: A harness mode is revoked (revoked_at), never deleted.
neverDeleted.policy.intents: A mandate is revoked (revoked_at), never deleted.
neverDeleted.policy.tool_names: Tool names are added by migrations only; no role can delete one.
neverDeleted.vault.source_accounts: A source account's id is kept by every row derived from it and by its erasures; no statement deletes one.
